title: MAP SA
description: map.ch MAP SA Swiss communications agency in Cossonay, Vaud (UID CHE-106.859.955), operating since 1968 as a business; the current legal entity was registered in 1981. It's a ~13-person full-service shop covering brand strategy, SEO/SEA, social media, and event management. Leadership: Sébastien Graap (took over 2003) and Caroline Müller (partner since 2008). Only revenue figure ever made public is ~CHF 2M for 2010; no current financials are disclosed anywhere. Core clients are French-speaking Swiss SMEs and public bodies — CarPostal, Transports publics de la région lausannoise, La Source, Yverdon Énergies, Changins. A separate training arm, map.academy, publishes rates (CHF 800–3,900 packages, CHF 1,200/day, CHF 890/month coaching); agency project work is quote-only. Portfolio runs ~30 cases with claimed results (e.g. 7% energy savings, 1,200+ event visitors)
